title: Let apps run in the background: force deny (documented policy)
description: Sets the documented group policy value LetAppsRunInBackground to 2 (force deny) under HKLM Software Policies Microsoft Windows AppPrivacy. Store apps can no longer run in the background; this also affects their live tiles and push updates until undone. The previous value and its type are captured in a snapshot before the change and restored by per-feature undo.
